function.name: permission.resolve_reply
function.description: Resolve a user's natural-language reply to one pending permission request.

decision.description: approve for clear consent, reject for clear refusal, clarify when the reply is ambiguous or asks a question.

note.description: Optional rejection reason. Used only when decision is reject.

message.description: Clarifying message to send back to the user. Used only when decision is clarify.
